positions.name: LiveRamp Holdings
positions.catalyst: Publicis Groupe announced $38.50 all-cash buyout of LiveRamp Sun May 17 ($2.2B EV / $2.5B equity, 30% premium to Fri $29.66 close). Both boards approved, no financing conditions, expected close end-2026. Pre-market +26-27% to ~$37.30-37.59, leaving ~$1.20 (3.2%) deal-spread runway.
positions.risks: Initial-pop fade as arb funds rotate; spread already tight; regulatory/shareholder vote (low); broader ad-tech weakness if Trade Desk-style guides pressure peers.
positions.driver: Merger-arb deal spread with 30% buyout premium and no financing conditions.

positions.name: Macy's Inc.
positions.exitRule: 1-3 day swing (+5% TP / -5% stop / Wed close)
positions.catalyst: Berkshire Hathaway 13F filed Fri PM (May 15) disclosed a new 3.03M-share / ~$55M stake — first Berkshire dept-store position since 1966 and first 13F under new CEO Greg Abel. Stock +5-6% pre-market to ~$19.30 from Fri close $18.41.
positions.risks: Buffett-halo trades typically fade within 1-3 sessions; stake is small (~1.1%, immaterial to BRK); secular dept-store headwinds; Macy's still mid-restructuring (150 store closures by 2028).
positions.driver: Berkshire halo + first-ever Abel-era 13F = follow-on flow setup.
